Hi Mario,
The UI won't change until you have deployed an app I believe.  Try deploying a shinyapp by executing:  deployApp() and confirm that you can push apps up.

-Tareef


On Thu, Aug 7, 2014 at 11:35 PM, Mario Hinojosa <marioh...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

I have just signed in to shinyapps.io and after following the first steps (setting a username, installing shinyapps and loading it to R), I have tried to run the SetAccountInfo command:


shinyapps::setAccountInfo(
    name="mhinojosa", 
    token="AC86BBF9802DF0BB629974B6BA345ABB", 
    secret="<SECRET>")

I have pressed the "Show Secret" and subsequently copied the whole code into R and executed it. After a second or less of processing nothing happens in Rstudio and when I refresh the shinyapps website I still get the same message "hi you must be new here" which prompts me to input the aforementioned code.... My question here is whether this is normal, and will not change until I deploy a shiny app? or there's something wrong?

my specs are:
- macbook pro 2.4 GHz Inter Core i7
- OSX 10.9.4
- Rstudio version 0.98.944


Regards,

Mario
